data.one_liner: Android implementation of the path_provider plugin for finding commonly used locations.
data.what_it_does: Provides the Android-specific implementation for accessing commonly used paths on the filesystem, such as temporary or application support directories. It is usually consumed via the endorsed main path_provider package.
use_when: You are developing a Flutter app for Android and need to find standard filesystem paths.
You are using the path_provider package and need the underlying Android platform implementation.
avoid_when: You are targeting platforms other than Android and require a platform-agnostic approach (use path_provider instead).
strengths: Automatically included as an endorsed package when using path_provider.
Handles Android-specific path resolution using JNI.
weaknesses: Tied directly to the Android platform implementation.
Not intended to be used standalone unless directly accessing its specific APIs.
data.setup_notes: Endorsed plugin, automatically included by path_provider. Add to pubspec.yaml only if importing directly.

alternatives.name: path_provider
alternatives.why_pick_it: The main federated package that automatically bundles this implementation for cross-platform usage.
